description: Create WhatsApp AI Bot Google Opal prompt document and architecture design. Document the complete system: how agents work, how the server handles DDoS/rate limiting, Docker/Kubernetes status, and SMS/WhatsApp channel readiness.
steps: Create docs/WHATSAPP_BOT_OPAL_PROMPT.md with a Google Opal prompt for a WhatsApp AI bot that: (1) verifies parent identity via registered phone number, (2) answers attendance, exam dates, PTM schedule, hostel mess menu, holidays, (3) responds in Marathi by default (English if asked), (4) includes safety guardrails (never reveal other students' data, never impersonate staff)

Create docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md documenting: (1) How each ADK agent works (admission, attendance, hostel, academic, general) with provider fallback chain (Python ADK -> Gemini -> OpenAI/Anthropic), (2) How the server handles multiple concurrent requests (concurrency gates, event loop, Express async handlers), (3) DDoS/DoS protection layers: per-IP global rate limit (180/min), per-account rate limits on login (5/min), OTP send (5/10min), OTP verify (10/10min), AI chat (20/min), TTS (10/min), data read (120/min), data write (30/5min); concurrency gates on AI (8), TTS (4), data (32); Supabase-backed durable rate limiting with atomic RPCs, (4) Docker container status: Dockerfile exists (multi-stage Node 22 Alpine, health checks), docker-compose.yml for local dev, (5) Kubernetes status: full manifests exist in k8s/ (deployment, service, ingress, HPA, configmap, secrets, namespace) with auto-scaling 2-5 replicas on 70% CPU, (6) SMS/WhatsApp channel status: NOT ACTIVE (no WhatsApp Business API credentials, no SMS provider). Only email OTP is active via Resend (sandbox mode, single verified recipient). WhatsApp integration requires: WhatsApp Business API account, phone number verification, webhook endpoint, template message approval. (7) Rate limit details table showing every protected endpoint with bucket, limit, window, and what happens when exceeded
Create docs/DEPLOYMENT_GUIDE.md documenting: Vercel deployment (SPA + serverless), Docker build/run commands, Kubernetes deployment steps, environment variables reference
acceptance_criteria: docs/WHATSAPP_BOT_OPAL_PROMPT.md exists with a complete, actionable Google Opal prompt
docs/SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE.md exists with detailed explanations of agents, rate limiting, DDoS protection, container/orchestration status, and SMS/WhatsApp readiness
All documentation is accurate to the actual codebase (references real file paths, real rate limit values, real endpoint paths)
verification: Verify docs/ directory exists with all three files
findings: All three docs created with accurate references to actual codebase. Lint (tsc --noEmit) and build (vite + esbuild) pass cleanly. Documentation references real file paths, actual rate limit values, actual endpoint routes, and actual environment variable names from the codebase.
